# Draft:2026 Presidents Cup

The 2026 Presidents Cup will take place at Medinah country club in Illinois, USA. Team USA currently holds the Presidents Cup with their 2024 win at Royal Montreal over the international team. Medinah is the fifth different venue in the United States to host the Presidents Cup and adds the biennial team event to an illustrious list of tournaments hosted at Course #3 that include the 2019 BMW Championship, 2012 Ryder Cup, two PGA Championships, three U.S. Opens, the 1988 U.S. Senior Open, three Western Opens (BMW Championship), and a number of other professional championships.
